name: Presbyterian-Reformed Ministries International
addr: 3227 N Fork Left Fork, Black Mountain

reviews.t: This has been a very special, life-changing place for me. So many deep encounters with the Holy Spirit, and such a wonderful bunch of people to work with.

I came to an event here, with very thorough Biblical teaching and practical application. The participants and facilitators had amazing fellowship together over meals and coffee breaks. It was inspiring and refreshing to walk in the beautiful grounds before and after the event.

This is a life giving ministry. The people really care about you. Lots of other denominations attend not just Presbyterian. They trust Christ for all their provisions. They don't charge for any of the training or workshops. They rely solely on donations. I've learned a lot through this ministry and have received much healing through their healing prayer ministry.

I've enjoyed learning here during leadership development and family events. Beautiful setting to focus, relax and heal. A secret refuge for empowering, encouragement and energizing. The ministry creates a venue for personal and corporate growth. I highly recommend and encourage attending teachings created by, and for, this particular ministry.

PRMI provides some of the best teaching on the person and work of the Holy Spirit that I've ever encountered. Wonderful teaching on prayer too. If you're looking for solid, Biblical teaching this is the place to go.

PRMI family and Dunamis teaching has enriched and impacted my life so much. This teaching has Increased my love for the LORD JESUS CHRIST and the desire in my heart to serve and honor Him for all of my days. In some ways it’s scripture come to life.

Genuine, authentic ministry teaching people about the person and works of the Holy Spirit. This ministry has impacted my faith journey profoundly and I highly recommend their Dunamis events if you ever get a chance!

The ministry of PRMI has revolutionized my life and ministry! I grew up in a context where (even through Christian college and seminary) I didn't know and was never taught very much about the person and work of the Holy Spirit. As a result, I mostly adopted the (default) western secular worldview which doesn't allow much room in my life for the powerful work of the Holy Spirit. But then PRMI came along! Not only did they provide solid biblical teaching about the person and work of the Holy Spirit, but they also modeled for me the humility, grace, and gentleness that best accompany Spirit-empowered ministry! There have been two major "game changers" in my life as a disciple of Jesus Christ and a minister of the gospel. The first, obviously, was believing and growing in the gospel! The second was learning how to cooperate with the Holy Spirit in my life and ministry. In terms of impact and value, nothing I've ever done or read or experienced has even come close to these two. Praise God for PRMI!

This is a wonderful organization that does a lion's share of work on a shoe-string budget. Great people, great message, great outcomes. I highly recommend Reformed and Presbyterian believers to check out this ministry and for those who believe in what they are up to: give generously.

This ministry has been the single most impactful of my entire Christian life! Started back with hearing Brad speak one day in Princeton NJ in 1990....and continues today with yet another Dunamis Project....back in NJ!!
